# Fixtures for `subviewer` (SubViewer subtitles)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. The text is a script
for a fictitious harbour documentary; names, places and hosts (Saltmere, Ana Lighthouse, Ben Gull,
Mira Castell, `*.example`) are fictitious. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/subtitles.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `harbour-crafted.sub` | Written by `scripts/fixtures/craft_subtitles.py`: the [INFORMATION] header, `[br]` line breaks | CC0-1.0 |
| `harbour-v1-crafted.sub` | Written by `scripts/fixtures/craft_subtitles.py`: SubViewer 1, `[hh:mm:ss]` lines (ffmpeg reads it) | CC0-1.0 |
